summary: Configured persistent Apache name-based hosting on node1: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP 8080, unknown hosts receive HTTP 403, tenant trees remain isolated, and all approved content is preserved. SELinux remains enforcing and firewalld remains active. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were retained.
actions_performed: Installed the supported RHEL httpd package.
Configured deny-by-default, documentation, and purchasing virtual hosts.
Applied persistent SELinux content and port labels and opened 8080/tcp in firewalld.
Preserved a root-only rollback copy at /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf.pre-name-based-tenants.
Restarted node1 safely and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: docs.branch.test serves the supplied documentation tree
evidence.summary: The documentation index and handbook return the approved content, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: orders.branch.test serves the supplied purchasing tree
evidence.summary: The purchasing index and catalog return the approved content, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Both websites share TCP port 8080 with tenant isolation
evidence.summary: Apache reports both name-based virtual hosts on *:8080; the listener is active and cross-tenant file probes return 404.

evidence.requirement: Unknown Host headers receive an error rather than tenant content
evidence.summary: Unknown Host requests return HTTP 403 before and after restart.
Pre-change, post-change, and post-restart SHA-256 checksums are identical for every staged file.

evidence.requirement: Security controls and persistence are maintained
evidence.summary: Persistent SELinux labels and port policy are present, firewalld permits 8080/tcp, SELinux is Enforcing, and no restart-time AVC denials were recorded.

Healthy baseline boot ID 050a5b4c-6c7b-42ad-957a-b6a41a0d34db was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 5b680182-127f-4dc3-b152-aec052404072, and services, firewall, SELinux, sites, tenant isolation, and data all recovered.
